title: Home Screen Load and Render
description: Verify that the Home Screen loads and renders correctly on iOS, Android, and Web platforms within 3 seconds including user stats, quick actions, featured workouts, and AI recommendations.

steps.description: Launch the app on iOS platform and navigate to Home Screen
Home Screen elements including user stats, quick actions, featured workouts, and AI workout recommendation card are visible and loaded within 3 seconds
Repeat the above steps on Android device
Home Screen elements render correctly and within 3 seconds on Android
Open the Web app version and navigate to Home Screen
Home Screen elements render without errors and load within 3 seconds on Web

title: Workouts Screen Search and Filtering
description: Confirm that workouts can be searched and filtered by category, difficulty, and duration with real-time updates of displayed results.

steps.description: Navigate to Workouts Screen
Enter a search keyword for workouts
Displayed workouts list updates to match search query in real-time
Apply filter by workout category (e.g., strength)
Workouts list updates showing only workouts of selected category
Apply filter by difficulty (e.g., intermediate)
Only workouts matching difficulty filter appear in the list
Apply filter by duration (e.g., 30-45 mins)
Workouts displayed meet duration criteria

title: Workout Detail Screen Display and Start Workout
description: Validate that the Workout Detail Screen correctly displays exercises, instructions, and enables starting a workout session.

steps.description: Select a workout from the Workouts Screen
Workout Detail Screen shows all exercises and instructions clearly
Click the 'Start Workout' button
Workout session initiates and displays tracking interface without errors

title: Gyms Screen Search and Filter
description: Ensure that users can search and filter gyms by location, amenities, and class availability and results update in real-time.

steps.description: Open Gyms Screen
Enter a search term related to gyms (e.g., 'CrossFit')
Gym list updates to show gyms matching search term
Apply filters for amenities (e.g., pool, sauna)
Gyms displayed include selected amenities
Apply class schedule availability filter
Only gyms with classes available as per filter are shown

title: Gym Map Screen Location Display and Interaction
description: Verify that the Gym Map Screen displays accurate gym locations with clickable markers and centers on Viman Nagar effectively.

steps.description: Navigate to Gym Map Screen
Google Maps renders centered on Viman Nagar with all gyms marked
Click several gym markers on the map sequentially
Gym detail snippets appear correctly and without delay

title: Gym Detail Screen Functionality and Booking
description: Ensure that the Gym Detail Screen presents comprehensive information including amenities and class schedules, and allows users to book classes.

steps.description: Select a gym from Gym List or Map
Gym Detail Screen loads with amenities, class schedules, and booking options visible
Attempt to book a class from the schedule
Booking is successful and confirmation is shown

title: AI Chat Screen Real-time Fitness Consultation
description: Confirm the AI Chat interface correctly sends fitness questions, receives responses within 5 seconds, and maintains conversation history.

steps.description: Open AI Chat Screen
Send a fitness question to the AI
AI responds with relevant fitness advice within 5 seconds
Send multiple follow-up questions
Conversation history is preserved and displayed correctly

title: AI Workout Recommendation Card Relevance and Performance
description: Validate that AI-powered workout recommendations load within 3 seconds and present workouts personalized to the user's profile information.

steps.description: Navigate to Home Screen
AI Workout Recommendation Card loads within 3 seconds
Workout recommendations reflect user's fitness goals and levels

title: QR Code Scanner Check-in Functionality
description: Verify that the QR Code Scanner works with live camera feed, accurately scans gym QR codes, logs check-ins in Firestore, and shows confirmation messages.

steps.description: Open QR Code Scanner Screen and grant camera permission
Camera feed displays correctly and scanner is active
Scan a valid gym QR code
Check-in is logged in Firestore and confirmation message appears
Scan an invalid or incorrect QR code
Appropriate error message is displayed

title: User Profile Screen Data Display and Settings Management
description: Ensure the User Profile Screen correctly displays user statistics, subscription status, and allows updates to settings and logout functionality.

steps.description: Navigate to User Profile Screen
User stats, subscription info, and settings options are displayed correctly
Modify a user setting (e.g., notification preferences)
Changes save successfully and reflect immediately in the UI
Click logout button
User is logged out and redirected to login screen

title: Real-time Data Synchronization and Offline Handling
description: Verify that app data syncs reliably with Firebase Firestore in real-time and cached data is used correctly when offline.

steps.description: Perform data updates (e.g., booking a class, checking in) on one device
Changes reflect in real-time on another logged-in device
Disable internet connectivity and open the app
Cached data loads successfully and app operates with limited functionality
Restore internet connectivity
Data syncs and updates automatically without errors

title: Error Handling and Fallback UI for API Failures
description: Check that the app presents graceful error messages and fallback UI in case of API failures or network errors.

steps.description: Simulate OpenRouter API failure during AI Chat interaction
User sees a clear and informative error message with option to retry
Simulate Firebase Firestore network outage
App displays fallback UI indicating offline status and queued actions
Attempt to book a class during network outage
App queues the booking and processes it automatically once back online

title: UI Accessibility Compliance
description: Validate that UI components meet accessibility standards including minimum touch target sizes, appropriate contrast ratios, and font readability across platforms.

steps.description: Review UI elements on key screens: Home, Workouts, Gyms, Profile
All interactive elements meet recommended touch target size guidelines
Color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards
Fonts are legible and scalable according to user accessibility settings

title: Authentication and Authorization Flows
description: Verify that user authentication works properly including login, logout, session persistence, and secure profile access.

steps.description: Launch app and attempt login with valid credentials
User is authenticated successfully and navigated to Home Screen
Close and reopen app
User session persists and remains logged in
Logout from profile screen
User is logged out and redirected to login screen
Attempt accessing Profile Screen without login
Access is denied and user is redirected to login screen

title: Multi-device Responsive UI Behavior
description: Ensure that the app UI renders responsively and maintains usability across different device types including various iOS, Android phones, tablets, and web browsers with different window sizes.

steps.description: Access app on small-screen mobile device
UI layout adjusts gracefully with no clipping or overlapping elements
Access app on larger tablet device
UI utilizes additional screen space appropriately and navigation remains intuitive
Access app on desktop web browser and resize browser window
UI adapts responsively maintaining usability and correct element scaling
